ROW.COLUMN: This scenario monitors electronic transactions involving internal accounts, external entities, geographies, transaction channels, or transaction products that are deemed risky.

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @BUSINESS@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)
SELECT a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.EMP_ACCT_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT a inner join @BUSINESS@.EMP_ACCT b on (a.ACCT_INTRL_ID=b.ACCT_INTRL_ID)

select g.CUST_INTRL_ID, g.Cust_Seq_Id, g.Tot_Trans_Amt, g.Tot_Trans_Ct, g.Effctv_Risk_Lvl, g.Actvty_Risk_Lvl from ( select t.CUST_INTRL_ID, max(t.CUST_SEQ_ID) as Cust_Seq_Id, sum(t.TRXN_BASE_AM) as Tot_Trans_Amt, count(1) as Tot_Trans_Ct, max(t.Efctv_Risk_Lvl) as Effctv_Risk_Lvl, max(t.Actvty_Risk_Lvl) as Actvty_Risk_Lvl from ( -- ORIG select a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, c.CUST_SEQ_ID, c.cust_intrl_id, c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, w.orig_actvy_risk_nb as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, w.DATA_DUMP_DT, w.TRXN_BASE_AM from @BUSINESS@.WIRE_TRXN w inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on w.ORIG_ACCT_ID = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.CUST c on a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID where -- Include Institutional Customer Accounts Only a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD='CI' and w.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL = 'Y' -- Common filter for all IML scenarios and (a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst) or @All_Acct_Type_Fl='Y') and (c.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst) or @All_Jurisdictions_Fl='Y') -- Exclude Exempt Customers and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- PR 32608 :Effective Risk Level of the Focal Entity Performing the Transactions >= Effctv Risk Lvl -- or Activity Risk Level of the Transactions performed by the Focal Entity >= Actvty Risk Lvl and (c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB >=@Effctv_Risk_Lvl or w.ORIG_ACTVY_RISK_NB >= @Actvty_Risk_Lvl) -- Exclude Electronic Funds Transactions between Related Parties and (@Incl_Rltd_Parties ='Y' or nvl (w.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL,'Y') <>'N') -- Exclude Cancelled and Canceling Electronic Funds Transactions and w.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- See KDS00024611 -- Include both Electronic Funds Transactions and Electronic Securities Transactions and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- ------------------------------ and w.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL')
union all -- SCND ORIG select a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, c.CUST_SEQ_ID, c.cust_intrl_id, c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, w.SCND_ORIG_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, w.DATA_DUMP_DT, w.TRXN_BASE_AM from @BUSINESS@.WIRE_TRXN w inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on w.SCND_ORIG_ACCT_ID = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.CUST c on a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID where -- Include Institutional Customer Accounts Only a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD='CI' and w.INTRL_SCND_ORIG_ACCT_FL = 'Y' -- Common filter for all IML scenarios and (a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst) or @All_Acct_Type_Fl='Y') and (c.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst) or @All_Jurisdictions_Fl='Y') -- Exlude transaction where SCND_ORIG = ORIG and ((w.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL = 'Y' and nvl(w.ORIG_ACCT_ID,'-')<>w.SCND_ORIG_ACCT_ID) or w.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL <> 'Y') -- PR 32608 :Effective Risk Level of the Focal Entity Performing the Transactions >= Effctv Risk Lvl -- or Activity Risk Level of the Transactions performed by the Focal Entity >= Actvty Risk Lvl and (c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB >=@Effctv_Risk_Lvl or w.SCND_ORIG_ACTVY_RISK_NB >= @Actvty_Risk_Lvl) -- Exclude Exempt Customers and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Exclude Electronic Funds Transactions between Related Parties and (@Incl_Rltd_Parties ='Y' or nvl (w.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL,'Y') <>'N') -- Exclude Cancelled and Canceling Electronic Funds Transactions and w.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- See KDS00024611 -- Include both Electronic Funds Transactions and Electronic Securities Transactions and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- ------------------------------ and w.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL')
union all -- BENEF select a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, c.CUST_SEQ_ID, c.cust_intrl_id, c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, w.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, w.DATA_DUMP_DT, w.TRXN_BASE_AM from @BUSINESS@.WIRE_TRXN w inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on w.BENEF_ACCT_ID = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.CUST c on a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID where -- Include Institutional Customer Accounts Only a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD='CI' and w.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL = 'Y' -- Common filter for all IML scenarios and (a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst) or @All_Acct_Type_Fl='Y') and (c.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst) or @All_Jurisdictions_Fl='Y') -- PR 32608 :Effective Risk Level of the Focal Entity Performing the Transactions >= Effctv Risk Lvl -- or Activity Risk Level c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Exclude Electronic Funds Transactions between Related Parties and (@Incl_Rltd_Parties ='Y' or nvl (w.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL,'Y') <>'N') -- Exclude Cancelled and Canceling Electronic Funds Transactions and w.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- See KDS00024611 -- Include both Electronic Funds Transactions and Electronic Securities Transactions and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- ------------------------------ and w.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL')
union all -- SCND BENEF select a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, c.CUST_SEQ_ID, c.cust_intrl_id, c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, w.SCND_BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, w.DATA_DUMP_DT, w.TRXN_BASE_AM from @BUSINESS@.WIRE_TRXN w inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on w.SCND_BENEF_ACCT_ID = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.CUST c on a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID where -- Include Institutional Customer Accounts Only a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD='CI' and w.INTRL_SCND_BENEF_ACCT_FL = 'Y' -- Common filter for all IML scenarios and (a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst) or @All_Acct_Type_Fl='Y') and (c.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst) or @All_Jurisdictions_Fl='Y') -- Exlude transaction where SCND_BENEF = BENEF and ((w.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL = 'Y' and nvl(w.BENEF_ACCT_ID,'-')<>w.SCND_BENEF_ACCT_ID) or w.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL <> 'Y') -- PR 32608 :Effective Risk Level of the Focal Entity Performing the Transactions >= Effctv Risk Lvl -- or Activity Customers and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Exclude Electronic Funds Transactions between Related Parties and (@Incl_Rltd_Parties ='Y' or nvl (w.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL,'Y') <>'N') -- Exclude Cancelled and Canceling Electronic Funds Transactions and w.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- See KDS00024611 -- Include both Electronic Funds Transactions and Electronic Securities Transactions and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- ------------------------------ and w.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.DATA_DUMP_DT <= union all -- BACK_OFFICE select a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, c.CUST_SEQ_ID, c.cust_intrl_id, c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Lvl, bo.BO_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, bo.DATA_DUMP_DT, bo.TRXN_BASE_AM from @BUSINESS@.BACK_OFFICE_TRXN bo inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on bo.ACCT_INTRL_ID = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.CUST c on a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID where -- Include Institutional Customer Accounts Only a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD='CI' -- Common filter for all IML scenarios and (a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst) or @All_Acct_Type_Fl='Y') and (c.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst) or @All_Jurisdictions_Fl='Y') -- Exclude Electronic Funds Transactions between Related Parties and (@Incl_Rltd_Parties ='Y' or nvl (BO.UNRLTD_PARTY_CD,'Y') <>'N') -- PR 32608 :Effective Risk Level of the Focal Entity Performing the Transactions >= Effctv Risk Lvl -- or Activity Risk Level of the Transactions performed by the Focal Entity >= Actvty Risk Lvl and (c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB >=@Effctv_Risk_Lvl or bo.BO_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB >= @Actvty_Risk_Lvl) -- Exclude Exempt Customers and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions and bo.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- Include both Electronic Funds Transactions and Electronic Securities Transactions and bo.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_BO_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- ------------------------------ and bo.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and bo.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and bo.EXCTN_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and bo.EXCTN_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL')
) t group by t.CUST_INTRL_ID having -- Frequency_Period Period max(t.DATA_DUMP_DT) <= (select b.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and max(t.DATA_DUMP_DT) > (select add_days(b.CLNDR_DT, - @Frequency_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) ) g where (g.Tot_Trans_Amt >= @Min_Trans_Am or g.Tot_Trans_Ct >= @Min_Trans_Ct)

select a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID as cust_intrl_id, w.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID from @BUSINESS@.WIRE_TRXN w inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on w.SCND_ORIG_ACCT_ID = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.CUST c on a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID where -- Include Institutional Customer Accounts Only a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD='CI' and w.INTRL_SCND_ORIG_ACCT_FL = 'Y' -- Exlude transaction where SCND_ORIG = ORIG and ((w.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL = 'Y' and nvl(w.ORIG_ACCT_ID,'-')<>w.SCND_ORIG_ACCT_ID) or w.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL <> 'Y') -- Exclude Electronic Funds Transactions between Related Parties and (@Incl_Rltd_Parties ='Y' or nvl (w.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL,'Y') <>'N') -- PR 32608 :Effective Risk Level of the Focal Entity Performing the Transactions >= Effctv Risk Lvl -- or Activity Risk Level of the Transactions performed by the Focal Entity >= Actvty Risk Lvl and (c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB >=@Effctv_Risk_Lvl or w.SCND_ORIG_ACTVY_RISK_NB >= @Actvty_Risk_Lvl) -- Exclude Cancelled and Canceling Electronic Funds Transactions and w.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null -- Common filter for all IML scenarios and (a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst) or @All_Acct_Type_Fl='Y') -- Exclude Exempt Customers and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- See KDS00024611 -- Include both Electronic Funds Transactions and Electronic Securities Transactions and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- ------------------------------ and w.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL')

select a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID as cust_intrl_id, w.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID from @BUSINESS@.WIRE_TRXN w inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on w.BENEF_ACCT_ID = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.CUST c on a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID where -- Include Institutional Customer Accounts Only a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD='CI' and w.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL = 'Y' -- Exclude Electronic Funds Transactions between Related Parties and (@Incl_Rltd_Parties ='Y' or nvl (w.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL,'Y') <>'N') -- PR 32608 :Effective Risk Level of the Focal Entity Performing the Transactions >= Effctv Risk Lvl -- or Activity Risk Level of the Transactions performed by the Focal Entity >= Actvty Risk Lvl and (c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB >=@Effctv_Risk_Lvl or w.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB >= @Actvty_Risk_Lvl) -- Exclude Cancelled and Canceling Electronic Funds Transactions and w.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null -- Common filter for all IML scenarios and (a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst) or @All_Acct_Type_Fl='Y') -- Exclude Exempt Customers and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- See KDS00024611 -- Include both Electronic Funds Transactions and Electronic Securities Transactions and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- ------------------------------ and w.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL')

select a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID as cust_intrl_id, bo.bo_trxn_seq_id from @BUSINESS@.BACK_OFFICE_TRXN bo inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on bo.ACCT_INTRL_ID = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.CUST c on a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID where -- Include Institutional Customer Accounts Only a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD='CI' -- Common filter for all IML scenarios and (a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst) or @All_Acct_Type_Fl='Y') and (c.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst) or @All_Jurisdictions_Fl='Y') -- Exclude Electronic Funds Transactions between Related Parties and (@Incl_Rltd_Parties ='Y' or nvl (BO.UNRLTD_PARTY_CD,'Y') <>'N') -- PR 32608 :Effective Risk Level of the Focal Entity Performing the Transactions >= Effctv Risk Lvl -- or Activity Risk Level of the Transactions performed by the Focal Entity >= Actvty Risk Lvl and (c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB >=@Effctv_Risk_Lvl or bo.BO_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB >= @Actvty_Risk_Lvl) -- Exclude Exempt Customers and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions and bo.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- See KDS00024611 -- Include both Electronic Funds Transactions and Electronic Securities Transactions and bo.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_BO_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- ------------------------------ and bo.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and bo.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and bo.EXCTN_DT > (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and bo.EXCTN_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL')
